map.二者功能不同：碳酸钙提升不透明度、降低成本，滑石粉改善平滑度与印刷适性。配比需兼: The two serve different purposes: calcium carbonate raises opacity and lowers cost, while talc improves smoothness and printability. The mix must satisfy both and they are not interchangeable; a high filler loading sacrifices strength and needs a reinforcing agent.
map.加填量是不是越高越好？: Is a higher filler loading always better?
map.否。加填提高不透明度与平滑度，但会降低纸页强度、挺度与施胶度，并增加掉粉风险。应: No. Filling raises opacity and smoothness, but lowers sheet strength, stiffness and sizing, and increases dusting risk. Take the lower limit once opacity meets the target, to preserve strength.

map.成本优化时，在指标达标前提下调整高价与低价填料比例。: For cost optimisation, adjust the ratio of premium to low-cost filler while keeping the targets met.
map.排放量 = A × B (kg)，1 t = 1000 kg: Emission = A x B (kg), 1 t = 1000 kg
map.文化用纸（双胶、铜版）加填碳酸钙/滑石粉改善不透明度与平滑度，需控制两种填料配比: Adding calcium carbonate or talc to cultural papers (offset, coated) improves opacity and smoothness, so the ratio between the two fillers must be controlled.
map.碳酸钙和滑石粉能互相替代吗？: Can calcium carbonate and talc substitute for each other?

map.：总添加=100+50=150 份；配比(碳酸钙:滑石粉)=100:50=2.0: : total addition = 100+50 = 150 parts; ratio (calcium carbonate : talc) = 100:50 = 2.00:1; difference = 50 parts; average = 75 parts. Formula: ratio = a/b, total addition = a+b.
map.：碳酸钙占比=100÷150≈66.7%，滑石粉占比=50÷150≈33.3%；: : calcium carbonate share = 100/150 ≈ 66.7%, talc share = 50/150 ≈ 33.3%; if the total addition is fixed, convert each filler quantity at these proportions. Formula: share = a/(a+b)*100%.

map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.按绝干浆量与加填率计算填料加入量、留着量与“简化填料质量占比”；留着率为可修改示: Compute filler addition, retained amount and “simplified filler mass share” from oven-dry pulp and filling rate. Retention is an editable illustrative value; the result is not measured ash.
map.加入量 = 绝干浆量 × 加填率；留着量 = 加入量 × 示例留着率；简化填料质: Addition = oven-dry pulp × filling rate; retained = addition × illustrative retention; simplified filler mass share = retained ÷ (pulp + retained) × 100%. Pulp must exceed 0, filling rate cannot be negative and retention must be 0–100%; blanks or text raise an error and clear old results.
map.加填方案练习：比较不同加填率与留着率下的填料加入量、留着量与质量占比。: Filler-design exercise: compare addition, retained amount and mass share across filling and retention values.
map.成本与强度权衡：理解填料占比上升对纤维结合与成本的潜在影响。: Cost/strength trade-off: understand how a higher filler share can affect fiber bonding and cost.
map.数据核对：把本机台实测留着率替换示例值，缩小模型与实测差异。: Data check: replace the illustrative retention with measured values from your machine to reduce the gap.

map.模型假设纤维全部留着、无其他无机物、留着填料灼烧后与灰分等量，因此只适合估算与教: The model assumes all fiber is retained, no other inorganic matter and retained filler equals ash after ignition, so it is for estimation and teaching only. Actual ash depends on fiber retention, filler type, retention aid and ignition conditions; measure it by the applicable method. Do not use this result as an ash test or a pass judgement.
